proof_scope: Breakpoint-ownership persistence across an extension-host restart (#1433 durability): VS Code persists breakpoints across reloads, so a registry that lives only in memory turns the bridge's own stale breakpoints into preserved 'human' ones and hijacks the next stop at the previous line. The registry now persists to $XDG_RUNTIME_DIR/agent-skills-debugger/<hash>/owned-breakpoints.json and reloads on activation. DESTRUCTIVE: this case kills the VS Code extension hosts mid-run (reload equivalent); run it alone, not inside a larger live batch -- repeated kills destabilize the bridge for subsequent cases.

claims.proves: a live stop persists its owned breakpoint key to the runtime-dir registry (file read back), and after the extension hosts are killed and respawn, a stop at a NEW line lands on that line -- the reloaded registry still owns and removes the stale breakpoint
claims.does_not_prove: survival across a full VS Code application restart (only the extension host is restarted), or multi-window registry arbitration

cases.name: ownership-survives-extension-host-restart
cases.description: Stop at main.py:20 (owned bp persisted to the runtime dir), kill the extension hosts (reload equivalent), then stop at main.py:21: the frame must land on 21 -- the reloaded registry still owns and removes the stale :20 breakpoint.
command: set -uo pipefail; WS="${DEBUGGER_VSCODE_WORKSPACE:-}"; [ -z "$WS" ] && { echo BRIDGE_BLOCKED; exit 0; }; RS="$WS/skills/debugger/run.sh"; sleep 10; ok=''; for attempt in 1 2; do (cd "$WS" && "$RS" stop "$WS/skills/debugger/scenarios/variable_state/main.py:20" --local first >/dev/null) && { ok=yes; break; }; sleep 15; done; [ -n "$ok" ] || { echo BRIDGE_BLOCKED; exit 0; }; command ls ${XDG_RUNTIME_DIR:-/tmp}/agent-skills-debugger/*/owned-breakpoints.json >/dev/null 2>&1 && echo REGISTRY-PERSISTED || { echo NO-REGISTRY-FILE; exit 1; }; for p in $(pgrep -f 'node.mojom.NodeServic[e]'); do kill "$p" 2>/dev/null || true; done; sleep 30; OUT=''; for attempt in 1 2; do OUT=$(cd "$WS" && "$RS" stop "$WS/skills/debugger/scenarios/variable_state/main.py:21" --local second) && break; OUT=''; sleep 10; done; [ -n "$OUT" ] || { echo BRIDGE_BLOCKED; exit 0; }; SP=$(echo "$OUT" | grep '^STATUS_PATH' | awk '{print $2}'); L=$(python3 -c "import json,sys;print((json.load(open(sys.argv[1])).get('stoppedState') or {}).get('frame',{}).get('line'))" "$SP"); echo "frame-line=$L"; [ "$L" = "21" ] && echo OWNERSHIP-SURVIVED-RESTART || { echo STALE-BREAKPOINT-HIJACKED-STOP; exit 1; }
